paragraphs: An ongoing Salmonella outbreak linked to broccoli sprouts has sickened 32 people across six states, with three hospitalizations reported [1]. The outbreak was first identified on September 9 and has spread to two additional states as of September 24 [18].
An E. coli outbreak tied to frozen blueberries is now over [2]. That outbreak affected 17 people across two states, with six hospitalizations and no deaths [2].

Star Meat Delivery Inc. is recalling over 83 tons of raw pork, beef, and goat products sold under the A&D Foods label because they were produced without federal inspection [3][26]. Fontanini Foods LLC is recalling 2,320 pounds of raw, frozen pork breakfast sausage that may contain clear, hard plastic [11]. Deano's Pasta is recalling approximately 20 pounds of Pear and Pecorino Triangoli Ravioli due to undeclared lobster, which poses a serious or life-threatening risk to those with crustacean shellfish allergies [4][9]. Berlin Seeds is recalling 950 pounds of alfalfa sprouting seed because it may be contaminated with Shiga toxin-producing E. coli and/or Salmonella [7]. Galil Importing Corp is recalling Lior Cinnamon Ground Seasoning for elevated lead levels [5], and G. L. Mezzetta Inc. is recalling Mezzetta Brand Golden Greek Peperoncini for a pest contaminant [6].
